articles.title: Council Votes on Senior Exercise Class After Long Debate
articles.deck: Residents of Foxglove Heights filled the hall on Sunday to ask questions about the plan.
body: The Foxglove Heights Improvement Group will post updates on its bulletin board outside the library. Organizers say the project is on schedule and that volunteers are still needed on Sunday mornings.
The plan calls for senior exercise class along Kiln Street, with work expected to start in June. Public works estimates the work will take about 11 weeks once it begins.
Leona Emerson, who has lived in Foxglove Heights for 11 years, said the response has been better than anyone expected. The group has raised $850 so far and is asking for help with supplies and food.

articles.title: Letter: Support the Street Tree Planting
body: To the editor: Please keep the street tree planting in the budget. Many of us on Harbor Terrace use it every week. To the editor: I have lived on Harbor Terrace for 5 years, and I want to say what a difference the Hickory Ridge Recreation Center has made.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the February meeting. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Bernadette Lacey, Mill Hill
